'''Barab Ingots''' (also called '''Barab ore ingots''') were rare [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lightsaber crystals]] found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Barab I/Legends|Barab I]], found inside the ore littering the planet's [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]]-baked surface. Though the radiation on the surface made it difficult to find these crystals, a few managed to locate Barab ingots suitable for use as focusing crystals.<ref name="Jedi Academy Training Manual" /> When used in a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], the ingots produced a blade that burned almost to the point of losing its cohesion.<ref name="KOTOR II">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>

==Properties==
The constant infusion of radiation from Barab I's surface caused a Barab ingot to produce a blade that burned like [[Fire/Legends|fire]], even causing the target of the blade to catch fire. The color of a Barab ingot blade varied, with ingots of every common blade color having been found.<ref name="Jedi Academy Training Manual" />

==Behind the scenes==
In "[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures]]," the Barab bar has nothing to do with [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] and instead is crafting material that can be used to craft various things. It also appears to be a rectangle instead of a crystal.
